svg.title: Somebodies just like you — U.S. suicide deaths in 2022
svg.desc: A pie composed of exactly 49,476 individual marks, one per recorded death. Male: 39,273, 79.4 percent. Female: 10,203, 20.6 percent. Sex as reported in mortality data. Source: CDC NCHS Data Brief 509, September 2024. Heading excerpt from Anni McHenry’s poem.

g.text: By sex recorded in the mortality data.
CDC / NCHS · Data Brief 509 · Published September 2024
